purpose: Verify that only a SysAdmin or Super Admin can trigger a manual backup
preconditions: Authenticated SysAdmin or Super Admin account exists; BADMS is operational
action_or_input: SysAdmin triggers an on-demand (manual) backup
expected_result: BADMS accepts the trigger and begins backup execution

purpose: Verify that a non-authorized role cannot trigger a manual backup
preconditions: Authenticated user with a role other than SysAdmin or Super Admin exists
action_or_input: Non-authorized user attempts to trigger a manual backup
expected_result: BADMS denies the trigger; backup is not executed

purpose: Verify that BADMS collects the current timestamp and backup artifacts and saves a current-state database dump when a manual backup is triggered
preconditions: Authenticated SysAdmin; BADMS operational with accessible database
action_or_input: SysAdmin triggers a manual backup
expected_result: BADMS collects the current timestamp and backup artifacts and saves a current-state database dump together with its timestamp

purpose: Verify that BADMS records and communicates the outcome of a manual backup as Success
preconditions: Authenticated SysAdmin; BADMS operational; backup completes without error
action_or_input: SysAdmin triggers a manual backup that completes successfully
expected_result: BADMS records and communicates the backup outcome as Success

purpose: Verify that BADMS marks a failed manual backup as Failed and alerts the SysAdmin
preconditions: Authenticated SysAdmin; BADMS operational; conditions cause backup to fail
action_or_input: SysAdmin triggers a manual backup that cannot be completed
expected_result: BADMS marks the backup outcome as Failed and sends an alert to SysAdmin

purpose: Verify that BADMS executes automatic backups at scheduled times without user intervention
preconditions: A valid backup schedule exists for a dataset; the scheduled time arrives; repository is reachable
action_or_input: Scheduled time for automatic backup elapses
expected_result: BADMS executes the backup automatically without requiring any user action

purpose: Verify that BADMS identifies eligible datasets and transfers them to backup recovery storage during automatic backup
preconditions: Automatic backup triggered at scheduled time; repository is reachable
action_or_input: Automatic backup executes at scheduled time
expected_result: BADMS identifies and reads eligible datasets under the applicable schedule and transfers them to backup recovery storage

purpose: Verify that BADMS verifies backup integrity/consistency and logs the automatic backup with timestamp and status
preconditions: Automatic backup has transferred data to recovery storage
action_or_input: Automatic backup execution completes data transfer
expected_result: BADMS verifies backup integrity and consistency; logs the backup with its timestamp and status

purpose: Verify that BADMS does not execute an automatic backup when the relevant repository is unreachable
preconditions: A valid backup schedule exists; scheduled time elapses; relevant repository is unreachable
action_or_input: Scheduled backup time arrives with repository unreachable
expected_result: BADMS does not execute the scheduled automatic backup

purpose: Verify that the current backup schedules are displayed to an authorized SysAdmin
preconditions: Authenticated SysAdmin; at least one local backup schedule exists
action_or_input: SysAdmin requests to view backup schedules
expected_result: BADMS displays the current backup schedules to the SysAdmin

purpose: Verify that a SysAdmin can create or modify a local backup schedule by specifying frequency, execution time, and data-classification filters
preconditions: Authenticated SysAdmin; no conflicting schedule for target dataset
action_or_input: SysAdmin creates a new local backup schedule specifying frequency, execution time, and data-classification filters
expected_result: BADMS accepts and applies the new local backup schedule

purpose: Verify that BADMS rejects an invalid or conflicting schedule configuration without applying it
preconditions: Authenticated SysAdmin; a conflicting or invalid schedule configuration is prepared
action_or_input: SysAdmin submits a schedule configuration that is invalid or conflicts with an existing schedule
expected_result: BADMS rejects the schedule configuration and makes no schedule-state change

purpose: Verify that after successful schedule validation BADMS applies the new schedule and logs the configuration change
preconditions: Authenticated SysAdmin; valid schedule parameters supplied
action_or_input: SysAdmin submits a valid new local backup schedule
expected_result: BADMS applies the new local backup schedule and logs the schedule configuration change

purpose: Verify that BADMS maintains backup status and history and allows authorized users and administrators to view them
preconditions: One or more backup operations have been executed; authenticated user or authorized administrator
action_or_input: User or authorized administrator requests to view backup history and current status
expected_result: BADMS returns the backup history and current status within the requester's authorized scope

purpose: Verify that an authenticated user can initiate a secure archival request
preconditions: Authenticated user; sufficient storage quota available
action_or_input: Authenticated user submits a secure archival request with all required metadata
expected_result: BADMS accepts the submission initiation from the authenticated user

purpose: Verify that a secure archival request captures all required metadata fields: file name, date, owners, file type, reason, and file attachment
preconditions: Authenticated user; preparing a secure archival request
action_or_input: User submits a secure archival request with file name, date, owners, file type, reason for secure archival, and file attachment
expected_result: BADMS captures all required metadata fields as part of the submission

purpose: Verify that BADMS validates request data and storage quota before accepting the submission; on failure it shows errors and makes no request-state change
preconditions: Authenticated user; submission with invalid data or exceeded storage quota prepared
action_or_input: User submits a secure archival request with invalid data or while quota is exceeded
expected_result: BADMS shows validation errors and makes no request-state change

purpose: Verify that on successful submission BADMS sets the secure archival request status to Submitted
preconditions: Authenticated user; valid submission data; quota not exceeded
action_or_input: User submits a valid secure archival request
expected_result: BADMS sets the request status to Submitted

purpose: Verify that BADMS routes a successfully submitted secure archival request to the HoD of the requester's department
preconditions: Valid secure archival request successfully submitted; request status is Submitted
action_or_input: BADMS processes a successfully submitted secure archival request
expected_result: BADMS routes the request to the HoD of the requester's department for review

purpose: Verify that if no initial classification is supplied, BADMS assigns Routine as the default classification
preconditions: Authenticated user; secure archival request prepared without an initial classification field
action_or_input: User submits a secure archival request omitting the initial classification
expected_result: BADMS assigns Routine as the default initial classification

purpose: Verify that the routed HoD can review request details, attachments, and policy context before deciding on a secure archival request
preconditions: A secure archival request has been routed to the HoD; authenticated HoD of the requester's department
action_or_input: HoD opens the routed secure archival request for review
expected_result: BADMS displays request details, attachments, and policy context to the HoD

purpose: Verify that the HoD can approve a secure archival request and that BADMS records the decision
preconditions: A secure archival request is pending at the HoD of the requester's department
action_or_input: HoD approves the secure archival request
expected_result: BADMS records the approval decision

purpose: Verify that the HoD can reject a secure archival request and that BADMS records the decision
preconditions: A secure archival request is pending at the HoD of the requester's department
action_or_input: HoD rejects the secure archival request
expected_result: BADMS records the rejection decision

purpose: Verify that only the HoD of the requester's own department is permitted to approve or reject that user's secure archival request
preconditions: A secure archival request is pending; a HoD from a different department attempts to act on it
action_or_input: HoD from a different department attempts to approve or reject the request
expected_result: BADMS denies the action; the HoD from the different department cannot approve or reject the request

purpose: Verify that after HoD approval BADMS routes the secure archival request to SysAdmin for classification
preconditions: HoD has approved the secure archival request
action_or_input: HoD approves the secure archival request
expected_result: BADMS routes the approved request to SysAdmin for classification

purpose: Verify that SysAdmin can review an approved secure archival request and classify the data as Critical, Sensitive, Routine, or Archival
preconditions: An approved secure archival request has been routed to SysAdmin; authenticated SysAdmin
action_or_input: SysAdmin reviews the request and assigns an authoritative classification (e.g., Sensitive)
expected_result: BADMS accepts the authoritative classification assigned by SysAdmin

purpose: Verify that BADMS applies security and retention rules according to the authoritative data classification
preconditions: SysAdmin has assigned an authoritative classification to an approved archival request
action_or_input: SysAdmin assigns an authoritative classification to the request
expected_result: BADMS applies security and retention treatment corresponding to the authoritative classification

purpose: Verify that if the authoritative classification is Sensitive, BADMS routes the request to IT Security for encryption configuration
preconditions: SysAdmin assigns Sensitive as the authoritative classification
action_or_input: SysAdmin assigns Sensitive classification to the archival request
expected_result: BADMS routes the request to the IT Security Team for encryption configuration

purpose: Verify that the IT Security Team can configure encryption for data classified as Sensitive
preconditions: An archival request classified as Sensitive has been routed to IT Security; authenticated IT Security Team member
action_or_input: IT Security Team configures encryption for the Sensitive-classified archival request
expected_result: BADMS accepts the encryption configuration from IT Security

purpose: Verify that after encryption configuration, BADMS creates the encrypted archive using AES-256 at rest and in transit and records the outcome
preconditions: IT Security has configured encryption for a Sensitive archival request
action_or_input: BADMS proceeds to create the archive after encryption configuration
expected_result: BADMS creates an encrypted archive using AES-256 encryption both at rest and in transit, and records the outcome

purpose: Verify that a user can track the status and history of a secure archival request throughout processing
preconditions: Authenticated user; a secure archival request previously submitted by that user is in progress
action_or_input: User requests status or history of their secure archival request
expected_result: BADMS displays the current status and history of the secure archival request to the user

purpose: Verify that BADMS sends a submission confirmation notification and decision notifications at approval/rejection stages for secure archival requests
preconditions: A secure archival request is submitted; later a HoD makes an approval or rejection decision
action_or_input: User submits a secure archival request; HoD subsequently approves or rejects it
expected_result: BADMS issues a submission confirmation notification on submission and a decision notification when the HoD approves or rejects

purpose: Verify that the Super Admin can perform a special archival operation for Sensitive research data following an offline request from any authority
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin; an offline request for special archival of Sensitive research data has been received
action_or_input: Super Admin performs the special archival operation in BADMS
expected_result: BADMS executes the special archival operation for Sensitive research data as performed by the Super Admin

purpose: Verify that only the Super Admin is permitted to perform the special archival operation in BADMS
preconditions: An offline special archival request exists; a user with a role other than Super Admin attempts to perform the operation
action_or_input: Non-Super Admin user attempts to perform the special archival operation
expected_result: BADMS denies the operation; only Super Admin can perform special archival

purpose: Verify that after the Super Admin performs a special archival operation, BADMS records the operation outcome and audit event
preconditions: Super Admin has performed a special archival operation
action_or_input: Super Admin completes a special archival operation
expected_result: BADMS records the operation outcome and creates a corresponding audit log event

purpose: Verify that a user can request restoration of archived data
preconditions: Authenticated user; archived data exists that the user is entitled to request
action_or_input: User submits a restoration request for archived data
expected_result: BADMS accepts the restoration request from the user

purpose: Verify that a restoration request for Sensitive data requires SysAdmin approval before restoration proceeds
preconditions: User has submitted a restoration request for data classified as Sensitive
action_or_input: User requests restoration of Sensitive archived data
expected_result: BADMS requires SysAdmin approval before restoration of Sensitive data proceeds

purpose: Verify that BADMS supports restoration of non-Sensitive archived data through the standard restoration procedure
preconditions: User has submitted a restoration request for data classified as non-Sensitive (e.g., Routine)
action_or_input: User requests restoration of non-Sensitive archived data
expected_result: BADMS processes the restoration through the standard restoration procedure without requiring SysAdmin approval

purpose: Verify that a user can track restoration-request status
preconditions: Authenticated user; a restoration request previously submitted by that user is in progress
action_or_input: User requests status of their restoration request
expected_result: BADMS displays the current status of the restoration request to the user

purpose: Verify that a user can submit a storage-extension request when their storage quota is full
preconditions: Authenticated user; user's storage quota is at capacity
action_or_input: User with full quota submits a storage-extension request
expected_result: BADMS accepts the storage-extension request submission

purpose: Verify that BADMS validates a storage-extension request against the user's current storage usage
preconditions: User submits a storage-extension request; BADMS has access to current storage usage data
action_or_input: User submits a storage-extension request
expected_result: BADMS validates the request against the user's current storage usage

purpose: Verify that BADMS routes a valid storage-extension request to the user's HoD for review
preconditions: A valid storage-extension request has been submitted by the user
action_or_input: User submits a valid storage-extension request
expected_result: BADMS routes the request to the user's HoD

purpose: Verify that the HoD can review storage-extension request details, attachments, available storage infrastructure, departmental policy, and the user's justification
preconditions: A storage-extension request has been routed to the HoD; authenticated HoD of the user's department
action_or_input: HoD opens the routed storage-extension request for review
expected_result: BADMS displays request details, attachments, available storage infrastructure, departmental policy, and the user's justification to the HoD

purpose: Verify that the HoD can approve a storage-extension request and that BADMS records the decision
preconditions: A storage-extension request is pending with the HoD
action_or_input: HoD approves the storage-extension request
expected_result: BADMS records the HoD approval decision

purpose: Verify that the HoD can reject a storage-extension request and that BADMS records the decision
preconditions: A storage-extension request is pending with the HoD
action_or_input: HoD rejects the storage-extension request
expected_result: BADMS records the HoD rejection decision

purpose: Verify that BADMS validates requested storage against available infrastructure and detects when a requested extension exceeds available storage
preconditions: User requests an extension amount that exceeds the available storage infrastructure
action_or_input: User submits a storage-extension request for an amount exceeding available infrastructure
expected_result: BADMS detects that the requested extension exceeds available infrastructure

purpose: Verify that BADMS monitors storage thresholds for all users
preconditions: BADMS is operational; users have storage allocations
action_or_input: BADMS executes its storage threshold monitoring function
expected_result: BADMS monitors and maintains storage threshold and full-quota condition information for all users

purpose: Verify that the Super Admin can define institution-wide global backup schedules and default backup policies
preconditions: Authenticated Super Admin
action_or_input: Super Admin defines an institution-wide global backup schedule and default backup policy
expected_result: BADMS accepts and stores the global backup schedule and default backup policy as defined by the Super Admin

purpose: Verify that a non-Super Admin role cannot define institution-wide global backup schedules
preconditions: Authenticated SysAdmin (or other non-Super Admin role)
action_or_input: SysAdmin attempts to define an institution-wide global backup schedule
expected_result: BADMS denies the operation; global backup schedules can only be defined by Super Admin

purpose: Verify that BADMS applies the global schedule to datasets when no valid local override exists
preconditions: A global backup schedule is defined; a dataset has no local backup schedule
action_or_input: Scheduled backup time arrives for a dataset without a local schedule
expected_result: BADMS applies the institution-wide global schedule to that dataset

purpose: Verify that a valid local backup schedule overrides the global schedule for that specific dataset
preconditions: Both a global backup schedule and a valid local backup schedule exist for the same dataset
action_or_input: Scheduled backup time arrives for a dataset with both global and local schedules
expected_result: BADMS applies the local backup schedule, overriding the global schedule for that dataset

purpose: Verify that BADMS enforces institute-defined retention rules according to data classification
preconditions: Institute-defined retention rules exist; archived data has an authoritative classification assigned
action_or_input: BADMS evaluates retention for data with a known authoritative classification
expected_result: BADMS enforces the institute-defined retention rules applicable to that data classification

purpose: Verify that when a backup is marked Failed, BADMS sends an alert to SysAdmin within five minutes
preconditions: A backup operation exists and is marked Failed
action_or_input: A backup is marked Failed
expected_result: BADMS sends an alert to the SysAdmin within five minutes of the failure

purpose: Verify that BADMS escalates to the Director of IT when three consecutive backup failures occur
preconditions: BADMS has recorded three consecutive backup failures
action_or_input: Third consecutive backup failure is recorded
expected_result: BADMS escalates the failure condition to the Director of IT

purpose: Verify that BADMS issues backup creation-status and completion notifications including failure alerts to SysAdmin
preconditions: A backup operation completes (either successfully or with failure)
action_or_input: Backup operation completes
expected_result: BADMS issues backup creation-status and completion notifications; failure alerts are sent to SysAdmin

purpose: Verify that BADMS notifies the requester when a storage-extension request is submitted
preconditions: User submits a valid storage-extension request
action_or_input: User submits a storage-extension request
expected_result: BADMS sends a notification to the requester confirming submission

purpose: Verify that BADMS notifies the requester when the HoD approves or rejects the storage-extension request
preconditions: A storage-extension request has been submitted; HoD makes an approval or rejection decision
action_or_input: HoD approves or rejects the storage-extension request
expected_result: BADMS sends a notification to the requester informing them of the HoD's approval or rejection decision

purpose: Verify that BADMS maintains audit logs for user actions, administrative actions, system events, and security events including timestamps, actor identifiers, actions, and outcomes
preconditions: BADMS is operational; a user action, administrative action, system event, or security event occurs
action_or_input: A loggable event (user action, administrative action, system event, or security event) occurs
expected_result: BADMS records an audit log entry containing timestamp, actor identifier, action, and outcome

purpose: Verify that a SysAdmin can view audit logs and activity histories
preconditions: Authenticated SysAdmin; audit log entries exist
action_or_input: SysAdmin requests to view audit logs and activity history
expected_result: BADMS displays audit logs and activity histories to the SysAdmin

purpose: Verify that the IT Security Team can audit data-activity logs for unauthorized access and review security-related reports
preconditions: Authenticated IT Security Team member; data-activity logs and security reports exist
action_or_input: IT Security Team member requests to audit data-activity logs and review security-related reports
expected_result: BADMS allows the IT Security Team to view data-activity logs and security reports

purpose: Verify that a HoD can view operational reports relevant to the HoD's own department and cannot view reports of other departments
preconditions: Authenticated HoD; operational reports for the HoD's department and for other departments exist
action_or_input: HoD requests to view operational reports
expected_result: BADMS shows only operational reports relevant to the HoD's own department; reports of other departments are not visible

purpose: Verify that BADMS provides operational visibility into backup operations to support monitoring and compliance verification
preconditions: Backup operations have been executed; authenticated authorized administrator
action_or_input: Authorized administrator accesses backup operational visibility
expected_result: BADMS provides operational visibility into backup operations for monitoring and compliance purposes

purpose: Verify that the IT Security Team can manage user permissions through RBAC
preconditions: Authenticated IT Security Team member; a user account exists
action_or_input: IT Security Team member modifies RBAC permissions for a user account
expected_result: BADMS applies the RBAC permission change as configured by the IT Security Team

purpose: Verify that the IT Security Team can define and enforce security policies governing encryption, access, and security controls
preconditions: Authenticated IT Security Team member
action_or_input: IT Security Team member defines a security policy governing encryption, access, or security controls
expected_result: BADMS accepts and enforces the security policy as defined by the IT Security Team

purpose: Verify that BADMS enforces role separation so that a HoD cannot act on requests outside their own department
preconditions: A request belonging to Department A is pending; a HoD from Department B attempts to act on it
action_or_input: HoD from Department B attempts to approve, reject, or otherwise act on a request from Department A
expected_result: BADMS denies the action and enforces departmental scope restrictions
